info.title: Auraflare API
info.description: Auraflare implementation contract. INR paise; host-only sessions and CSRF; owner and fulfillment permissions are server-enforced. Production commerce remains configuration-gated.

servers.description: Placeholder same-origin HTTPS host; replace per environment

sessionCookie.description: Laravel session. Bootstrap CSRF then send X-XSRF-TOKEN on mutations.

guestCookie.name: auraflare_session
guestCookie.description: Host-only HttpOnly Laravel session carrier. Cart ownership and each order grant are separate server-side capabilities; order IDs alone grant no access.

razorpaySignature.name: X-Razorpay-Signature
razorpaySignature.description: HMAC of exact raw request body using dedicated webhook secret.

InviteAccept.description: New invitee must supply name, password and confirmation; existing users must authenticate as the invited email. Token proves mailbox control; never overwrites an existing password.
